theme_strategy.rationale: A dark theme amplifies the vibrant green eco-friendly aesthetic, creating a premium, modern, and tech-forward feel. High contrast highlights the green actions (CTAs) and sustainability stats.

headings.usage: Hero texts, section titles, and dashboard metric numbers. Use tracking-tight for large text.

body.usage: Paragraphs, forms, data tables, labels. High legibility for dashboards.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadows. Rely on 1px borders (`border-white/10`) to separate dark surfaces.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Use glowing radial gradients behind key elements like the Hero CTA, using primary color with heavy blur (`bg-[#00FF66]/10 blur-3xl`).
visual_enhancers.radius: Slightly rounded (`rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl`) for a modern approachable tech feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain/noise overlay on the marketing landing page background to reduce digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_page: Bento grid (Mode A: The Tetris Grid) for Feature Highlights. Use `gap-6` or `gap-8`. Sections should have generous padding (`py-24` or `py-32`).
grids_and_layouts.dashboards: High-density grid (Mode B) for Seller/Collector Analytics. Tight gaps (`gap-4` or `gap-6`). Direct children of grid container.

component_instructions.header: Crystal Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10`). Fixed top, `z-50`.
component_instructions.logo: 3D Animated Logo: Use `framer-motion` to continuously rotate a recycling emblem SVG. Vibrant green with a subtle drop shadow glow.
component_instructions.hero_section: Dark background with a high-quality image overlay (`bg-black/50` or stronger to ensure text readability). Center-aligned massive text (`text-5xl md:text-6xl+`). 'Request Pickup' CTA must be solid vibrant green with black text for high contrast.
component_instructions.social_proof: Use large stat blocks (`text-5xl font-black text-[#00FF66]`) with uppercase tiny tracking labels (`tracking-[0.2em] text-xs`).
component_instructions.features_bento: Cardless or 1px border cards. Focus on 'Masked Calling' and 'In-Built Navigation' features. Add subtle green glowing borders on hover.
component_instructions.forms: Seller Auth & Pickup Order Form: Shadcn `Dialog`, `Form`, `Select`, `Input`. Use `bg-surface` for inputs with `focus:ring-[#00FF66] focus:border-[#00FF66]`.
component_instructions.collector_dashboard: Order Feed: Feed/List layout. Order Cards must have 'Masked Call' & 'Navigate' buttons (subtle gray background, white text, green on hover). Online/Offline switch in header using Shadcn Switch.
component_instructions.analytics: Use Recharts/Shadcn charts. Bar charts for scrap weight, Area charts for earnings. Keep tooltips dark with green accents.
component_instructions.admin_portal: Hidden access via footer lock icon. Clicking prompts a modal/input for passkey '8762'.
component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or slightly rounded (`rounded-lg`). Primary CTAs are solid green, black text. Secondary CTAs are outline or glass.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all cards (`-translate-y-1` + `border-[#00FF66]/50`). Buttons should scale down slightly on click (`active:scale-95`).
motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and feed items using framer-motion.
motion.3d_elements: Framer motion for 3D continuous rotation of the logo. Keep it lightweight.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure black text is used on the vibrant green primary buttons for APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Use `data-testid` on all interactive elements.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00FF66] focus:outline-none`) on all interactive elements.

image_urls.description: Crushed assorted beverage cans representing scrap.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic centered layouts for text unless it is the hero heading.
Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism (12-24px blur).
Do not apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
Avoid using emoji characters as icons. Use lucide-react exclusively.
Ensure generous spacing: use `p-6` or `p-8` inside cards. `py-24` for sections.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST have `data-testid`.
Do not use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers.

routing_structure./: Marketing Landing Page (Hero, Features, Stats, Footer with hidden lock icon for admin)
routing_structure./seller: Seller Dashboard & Pickup Order Form (requires mock auth/captcha)
routing_structure./collector: Collector Dashboard (Real-time Feed, Map/Navigate, Masked Call, Toggle Online)
